originalCompile.basis: INFRA-ALPHA-117: run 40765631053's make passed and its image gate failed; it wrote no build receipt, and none is ever invented. Its retained output was re-verified by run 40777816699

superImage.basis: Measured on the retained output by the ALPHA-116 diagnostic (run 40771878744) and matched again by run 40777816699 before and after its full gate

retainedVerification.basis: INFRA-ALPHA-120: the full verification (os-release.yml emulator-alpha-verify-retained, recipe e07d535) passed in run 40777816699. Its attempt directory was removed after the private artifact 12854389864 was uploaded, so the only copy of its receipt is that artifact: it is fetched through the workflow's own actions/download-artifact with the job token (actions: read), never from an executor blob route or a host path. The receipt file's sha256 was not recorded at hand-off (null): the run, artifact identity and API digest are checked, and the measured receipt digest is carried forward in every later receipt. A non-null value here is enforced exactly

export.basis: Exactly the top-level images and host package the original verification receipt measured, each re-hashed against it on the builder under the shared lock, plus that receipt and a sanitized export receipt. Files the receipt did not measure (for example android-info.txt) are not exported: they carry no verified hash

variables.ROSEOS_ALPHA_RUNTIME_READY: 'true' only after the runtime runner is registered in group roseos-alpha-runtime (restricted to this repository and this workflow) with label roseos-cuttlefish-runtime on pixel-os-smoke-20261023-a
variables.ROSEOS_RUNTIME_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDE: A NEW workload identity pool/provider whose attribute condition admits only this repository, workflow .github/workflows/alpha-runtime.yml, ref refs/heads/main and event workflow_dispatch; never the os-release provider
variables.ROSEOS_RUNTIME_CONTROLLER_SERVICE_ACCOUN: A NEW identity limited to compute.instances.get/start/stop on pixel-os-smoke-20261023-a only; no project, zonal-operations, signer or builder grant

runtime.basis: INFRA-ALPHA-120 proposal, not admitted infrastructure. Unverified host facts: launch_cvd/stop_cvd/adb come from the exported host package; adb listens on 0.0.0.0:(6520 + instance - 1); launch_cvd --daemon returns after boot or failure; the image directory needs no file the receipt did not measure. Each is checked at run time and reported, never assumed in a receipt
